notes: Manufacturer nominal data at 12 V. Local schematic revision 1.0 dated 2026-09-07 shows 6.5 V UBEC output to both servos. Physical voltage is unmeasured; 6.5 V motor performance is unknown. No automatic voltage scaling.
270 deg/s uses the published 45 rpm; 0.222 s per 60 degrees is rounded.
Stall torque is not continuous operating torque. Linear torque-speed behavior remains an approximation.
Product specification table gives 6-12 V; wiki gives 6-12.6 V. This preset uses their shared 12 V performance point.
Model simulates position control only; encoder quantization, serial timing and built-in acceleration are not simulated.
270 degree winding travel is an unconfirmed rig limit, not the ST3235 hardware angle limit. Continuous and multi-turn modes require a separate model.
Servo mass is not added to the ORK recovery mass; controller mass may already include the servos.
Schematic labels control nets PWM1/PWM2; ST3235 requires a TTL serial bus. Interface implementation/revision needs reconciliation.
